checked_scope: The sparse-support dictionary calculation and the k-coordinate BV lower submodel.
checks: Mean-zero component errors on independent uniform coordinates are L2-orthogonal before clipping. Thus approximation O((k+1)epsilon^2) and support count sum_(j<=k)C(d,j)<=(ed/k)^k give the displayed dictionary/selection costs without an extra k multiplier.

Square-wave cells with a=kappa/J have uniformly bounded component BV norm, orthogonal directions across coordinates, neighbor KL O(na^2/J), and total squared separation k a^2. J~n^(1/3) yields k n^-2/3.

Global outcome envelope requires ka bounded; therefore the lower family is only valid for k<=c n^(1/3). Separate one-coordinate selection alternatives prove log d/n, not the full upper support penalty k log(ed/k)/n. No unrestricted sharp sparsity frontier is claimed.
